title: Candidate
description: Implementer output, one per candidate. Each candidate is built by gemini-3.5-flash inside its own Gemini Managed Agents sandbox. The shape is the implementer's build_candidate output plus the one-line rationale from the implementer prompt. The candidate_id is the canonical identifier carried through the whole pipeline; it equals the strategy id from the Plan. environment_id is reused by the functionality judge so Playwright runs in the same sandbox that built the tool.

candidate_id.description: Canonical candidate identifier. Equals the strategy id from the Plan. The selector keys on this.

html.description: Complete single-file HTML tool with the shared token block inlined, one accent, one hero. No em dashes anywhere in the markup, text, or comments.

environment_id.description: Managed Agents environment id for the sandbox that built this candidate. Reused by the functionality judge.

steps.description: Number of agent steps the implementer took. Telemetry, optional.

rationale.description: One line naming the chosen accent and the layout decision. No em dashes.

accent.description: The single accent hex chosen from the approved set. Echoes the value assigned to --accent in the tool.

framework.description: Framework used, echoed from the strategy. Optional.

ux_emphasis.description: Emphasis used, echoed from the strategy. Optional.

examples.rationale: Rationale: red accent for workout urgency, hero clock centered with a single full-width Start timer in the thumb zone.
